title: AIFP Binding Declaration v1
description: Off-chain form of IAIFPChannelRegistry.BindingDecl. Capability names map to bits in the fixed order below (bit = 1 << index); governance effects and adoption modes use the listed codes. The on-chain declaration is the bitmask; this document is the readable form a binding publishes about itself.

target.description: Transport endpoint identifier, or the governance contract address left-padded to 32 bytes.

version.description: Version identifier of the target protocol or policy (bytes32).

capabilities.description: Transport capabilities. Bit order: identity 1<<0, rule-association 1<<1, push 1<<2, pull 1<<3, stream 1<<4, batch 1<<5, delivery-records 1<<6, history-retention 1<<7, late-join-history 1<<8, payload-protection 1<<9, metadata-protection 1<<10, membership-privacy 1<<11, total-order 1<<12, absence-detection 1<<13.

effectScope.description: Governance effects. Codes: rules = 1, participation = 2, disclosure = 4 (bitmask).

adoptionMode.description: automatic = 0 (the target executes directly), confirmed = 1 (the channel authority confirms each result)

authorizationRef.description: Reference to the evidence authorizing the binding; confers nothing by itself.
